description: This file defines a class 'Key' that wraps a string to hide it from stack traces and provides memory zeroing for cryptographic security. It includes methods for construction, memory clearing (destructor), retrieving the stored string, and getting its length.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a cryptographic key string, providing security features such as hiding its contents from debugging and zeroing out memory upon destruction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Key object with a string.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Attempts to securely zero out the internal string from memory.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.
